name: Daria Khlebnikova
about_artist_p1: Daria Khlebnikova was born in Omsk and graduated from the Faculty of Arts at OmGPU. She works both on her own artistic projects and in illustration for games, books, and other projects.
exhibition_2023: 2023 – Solo exhibition "Elusive Dreams", Kvadrat Gallery, Omsk
exhibition_2024: 2024 – 5th Regional Exhibition of Young Artists, Union of Artists, Omsk
exhibition_2025: 2025 - Interdisciplinary exhibition of contemporary art "NextArt. Immersion", CCA Artetage Vladivostok
about_art_p1: I create worlds that weave themselves into rhythmic structures, inviting the viewer to journey inward — into a space of living, breathing infinity. Paintings emerge like puzzles, slowly assembled layer by layer, growing organically from the fabric of life.
about_art_p2: The principle of decentralized composition, reminiscent of medieval art, allows each element to "grow" its own space around itself, free from a single dominant focus. I like contrasts between linear and reverse perspective, realism and stylization, futuristic and archaic imagery, biomechanics and Gothic forms.
about_art_p3: My work seeks balance between light and shadow, beauty and the grotesque. Through my images, I aim to evoke a sense of encountering something supernatural — at once familiar and strange.
about_art_p4: Dark fantasy, surrealism, magical realism, cosmism, romanticism, and symbolism have all shaped this visual language. I’m drawn to transitional states, transformations, and alchemical metamorphoses. Dreams are a big source of inspiration, I’ve been collecting and recording them for years. Often, imagery is rooted in archetypal and religious motifs, refracted through the prism of personal myth-making.  Myth, for me, is both a way of seeing and shaping the world.
metamorphosis_description: An ongoing series I have been working on since 2022, exploring contrasts and transformations — of people, creatures, deities, forms, styles, and emotions.
intergalactic: Intergalactic Ensemble of Crystal Gnomes on the Toad Planet
intergalactic_description:
The central themes of this work are music, medieval cosmism and the Garden of Eden.
Music has accompanied the most vivid experiences of my life since childhood. When I listen to it, it often generates visual images, mostly forms, lines and patterns rather than color.
This work was shaped under the influence of cosmic jazz of the Coltranes, Sun Ra, and medieval music. From this combination, a world emerged. Molecules grow from tiny points, becoming increasingly complex until, at a certain moment, they gain consciousness and begin to play their cosmic music, generating this space. The Planet of Toads is not so far from here, somewhere in the Andromeda Galaxy...
I used tempera for this work, it was important for me to bring together this ancient technique with a futuristic, semi-abstract vision.
embrace_description: In this painting, I aimed to create a space that feels primordial and ancient. It is a place beyond time, evoking states we do not consciously remember but carry within us — deep memories of a world before the separation of humans from nature. It gestures toward the dreamtime, and further back, to reptilian and amphibian epochs.
prince_amigdala_description: This painting was born from a dream in which a black creature descended upon me, tearing through the familiar fabric of reality. It was tangible to me, yet invisible to another figure in the dream. Paradoxically, I felt guilt for what had occurred, even though the attack did not originate from me. For me, this became a metaphor for psychological trauma: experiences that we alone can see may remain entirely imperceptible to others. The figure of the "Prince" embodies the threshold between neurophysiology and mythology. The amygdala in the brain is associated with memory, fear, and emotional response. It is an archetypal image of a being that brings change to the existing reality, carrying signs — symbols of something being born beyond words. The architecture in the background is an organic temple, a kind of four-dimensional space composed of psychic reflections, constructed from rhythm and repetition. Each fragment of space contains a trace of another fragment, and each image becomes an entry point into the next. The shards in the work are not merely symbols of destruction. Reflected again and again, they become material for a new construction, for new worlds yet unknown.It serves as a document of subconscious structures and the process of rewriting within oneself the elements that have outlived their purpose.
night_description: This work weaves together references to Dante’s Divine Comedy, the Tibetan Book of the Dead, and mythologies from various cultures to construct an inner landscape where the soul’s  journey unfolds. Bardo Chönyid is a transitional state filled with archetypal visions. Whether peaceful or terrifying, they are ultimately illusory: manifestations of the mind itself, intended to guide the soul toward enlightenment. On the left side of the composition, we see spiritual guides — Virgil, Charon, the Minotaur — over whom miniature muses hover. From the chaos emerge various beings, dakinis and harpies. In the lower right corner, a labyrinth of neurons represents the mind as the source of all these illusions. Simple, tiny figures grow and transform into deities — a metaphor for both the evolution of ideas within consciousness and the evolution of the physical world shaped by sentient beings. All of it arises within the mind that generates reality. Skulls and female forms symbolize the unity of life and death, while serpents represent the flow of vital energy. As one travels deeper into the painting, the forms become increasingly abstract, leading the viewer beyond the familiar, toward the white light of the Dharmakaya, the non-dual state of pure awareness.
snake_and_flower_main_description: 2022 38х54cm tempera, watercolor, isograph, pencil on paper
snake_and_flower_description: This painting is a meditation on time and reality, expressed through the interplay of the animalistic and the abstract, the heaviness and lightness of existence. The work is based on a dream I had of a serpent flying from one end of infinity to the other — a symbol of time itself. From its body grew clusters of new serpent heads, representing all possible variations of events. In contrast to this image, another figure appears: a spirit dancing in the twilight of dawn, adorned with tiny ringing bells. Part of me, in the moment, is fully immersed in this experience, while another part, the soul, exists outside of time, present in all moments at once, containing every state and emotion while being more than their sum. Perhaps this part of the soul remains untouched, a place where nothing ever truly happens.
phenomena_description: A series of my early works created between 2013 and 2019 at different times, united by the theme of human encounters with various phenomena and visions both in the world and within oneself.
spirtis_description: A series of works I began in 2023, dedicated to fantastic semi-abstract beings.
road_description: This work is about spiritual transformation, and bringing order to chaos. The central image is the angel of the desert and the sword that cuts through the mental defilements. The landscape resembles the desert of reality, overflowing with meaningless information. I worked with stone textures in a way that they live their own life, unfolding as organic forms. The overloaded mass of the landscape merges into a single chthonic environment.
meeting_description: In this work, I explore the experience of stepping beyond the boundaries of the self and meeting phenomena greater than human existence — whether destiny, chaos, love, or the forces of nature. These are moments of contact with the Other, and at the same time of recognizing reflections of oneself, often ambivalent in their nature.
river_description: This work is an allegory of a person’s inner struggle with themselves and the conflicting forces within the soul. The armor symbolizes the ego’s defensive psychological mechanisms, masks, and aggressive drives toward control and domination over nature. The river represents purification, movement, and transformation.
labyrinth_description: This work is a reflection on the infinities of nature and mind, unfolding in opposite directions of vision — outward into the world and inward into the self, through two modes of seeing. It also contemplates states of entanglement and wandering within the labyrinth, as well as moments of crystalline clarity.
